Name: You Are Here
Author: mnsnmomo
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
[b]You Are Here[/b] makes the world map easier to read. Your own head gets a colored outline, so you can spot yourself at a glance. With NPC Map Locations installed, villagers you haven’t talked to today get a small speech bubble, and a dropdown beside the map lets you show only the NPCs you care about right now.
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*][b]Recommended:[/b] install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url] to turn on the talk bubbles and the NPC filter.[/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings in-game.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder, or install it with Vortex. Use only one method; if the same mod is installed twice, SMAPI skips both copies.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]A colored outline that follows the shape of your head and hair, with a soft second outline that gently pulses.[/*]
[*]Only appears on the map region you’re actually in.[/*]
[*]Only your own head is outlined, so you can find yourself among other players in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]9 colors to choose from.[/*]
[/list][b]Haven’t talked today[/b][i](needs NPC Map Locations)[/i]
[list]
[*]A small speech bubble on NPCs you haven’t talked to yet today. It disappears once you talk to them.[/*]
[/list][b]Show NPCs dropdown[/b][i](needs NPC Map Locations)[/i]
A small dropdown beside the map that picks which NPCs are shown:
[list]
[*][b]All NPCs[/b][/*]
[*][b]Worth visiting[/b]: has a birthday or a quest, or you haven’t talked to them yet today[/*]
[*][b]Not talked to[/b]: you haven’t talked to them yet today[/*]
[*][b]Can give a gift[/b]: follows the game’s limits (one gift a day, two a week, no weekly limit on birthdays or for your spouse)[/*]
[*][b]Birthday today[/b][/*]
[*][b]Has a quest[/b]: Help Wanted quests, plus delivery, monster, fishing, gathering and lost-item quests in your journal[/*]
[*][b]Datable singles[/b][/*]
[/list]Press [b]V[/b] on the map to switch between All NPCs and the last filter you picked.

[b][size=4]Settings[/size][/b]
Everything can be turned on or off in Generic Mod Config Menu or in config.json: the outline, its color, the pulse, the talk bubbles, and the filter key.

[b][size=4]Good to know[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Works with the vanilla map, NPC Map Locations and World Maps.[/*]
[*]Tested alongside Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and East Scarp.[/*]
[*]The dropdown needs a mouse.[/*]
[*]English only for now. Translations are welcome.
folder).[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] 1.6 or later[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0 or later[/*]
[*][b]Recommended:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url]. It’s needed for the talk bubbles and the Show NPCs dropdown. Without it, you still get your head outline.[/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game settings.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Shout outs[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Bouhm[/b] for NPC Map Locations, which the NPC features build on.[/*]
[*][b]shekurika[/b] for World Maps.[/*]
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] for SMAPI and the mod build tools.[/*]
[*][b]spacechase0[/b] for Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b] for Stardew Valley.[/*]
[/list]
